workSource.title: Magic link login with Redis sessions

oneLiner: Users sign in via email magic link; sessions live in Redis with TTL; existing password login unchanged.
requirementSummary: AUTH-88 adds passwordless magic link for B2B users: request link by email, one-time token, session cookie, 7-day sliding TTL in Redis—must not break password auth.

integration.summary: Public API issues signed tokens stored in Postgres `magic_links`, sends email via existing queue, exchange endpoint validates token and writes session to Redis; browser gets HttpOnly cookie.
integration.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  User[Browser] --> API[identity-api]
  API --> PG[(Postgres magic_links)]
  API --> Q[email queue]
  API --> Redis[(Redis sessions)]
  Q --> SES[Email provider]
integration.mermaidSequence:
sequenceDiagram
  actor User
  participant API as identity-api
  participant PG as Postgres
  participant Q as email queue
  participant Redis
  User->>API: POST /auth/magic-link/request
  API->>PG: insert token hash
  API->>Q: enqueue email
  User->>API: GET /auth/magic-link/consume?token=
  API->>PG: validate + burn token
  API->>Redis: SET session
  API-->>User: Set-Cookie session

agentConsiderations.question: Store sessions in Postgres instead of Redis?
agentConsiderations.resolution: Redis matches existing session layer for password login; avoids new table migration this sprint.

agentConsiderations.question: JWT in URL vs opaque token?
agentConsiderations.resolution: Opaque token in DB; link single-use; shorter URL for email clients.

agentConsiderations.question: Same cookie name as password sessions?

worthMentioning: Rate limit on magic-link request is 5/hour/email—document in OpenAPI.
Email template must ship before enabling flag in prod.
Token TTL 15 minutes; session TTL 7 days sliding.

humanValidation.headline: Verify happy path + token reuse blocked + password login still works.
correctSignals: Request link → email enqueued → consume sets cookie → Redis key exists with TTL.
Second consume with same token returns 410.
Password login flow unchanged in smoke test.
Expired token returns 401 with generic message (no user enumeration).
redFlags: Magic link works but password sessions broken (cookie domain/path mismatch).
No rate limit on request endpoint.

quickChecks.passIf: One email; link works once; session calls /me successfully
Same session behavior as before MR

planBaseline: Redis session same as password path
